# TheSocialPundit

> TheSocialPundit is an AI-assisted professional authority platform. It helps professionals discover relevant industry news, shape a clear point of view, draft posts in their own voice for LinkedIn and 20+ other networks, and approve every post before it is published.

Key facts:

- Built for individual professionals: executives, founders, consultants, sales and marketing professionals, recruiters, agency leaders and analysts.
- Discover follows regional news editions and explains why each story fits the user's brief; Create drafts a post that takes a position, in a tone the user chooses.
- Nothing is published without the user's action. Direct publishing is available for supported networks; other networks receive copy-ready versions.
- Users' drafts and topics are not used to train models for other users.
- There is a free plan with no card required. Current plans and prices are on the pricing page; do not infer them.
- The app is in English; news editions cover North America, Europe, India, Japan, Australia and Brazil.

## Product

- [AI LinkedIn Posts From Your Industry News](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/): TheSocialPundit turns current news in your industry into LinkedIn and social posts written in your voice. You review and approve every post before it publishes.
- [How It Works: AI Posts From Industry News](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/how-it-works): See how TheSocialPundit finds current news in your field, drafts LinkedIn and social posts in your voice, and waits for your approval before anything publishes.
- [Pricing](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/pricing): Start building professional authority for free, then upgrade when you need the complete creation, scheduling, publishing, and performance workflow.
- [Use Cases](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/use-cases): Explore how TheSocialPundit supports thought leadership, professional content creation, and multi-platform publishing—with you in control.
- [Thought leadership](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/use-cases/thought-leadership): Build credible thought leadership from current industry signals, your expertise, and a point of view you approve before publishing.
- [Professional content creation](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/use-cases/professional-content-creation): Turn a current story, useful link, or original idea into a professional social post with source context and human approval.
- [Multi-platform publishing](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/use-cases/multi-platform-publishing): Adapt one professional point of view for the social platforms your audience uses, then review, schedule, publish, or copy each version.

## Free tools

- [Free LinkedIn Tools: Posts, Hooks, Hashtags](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/tools): Free LinkedIn writing tools with no sign-up: turn news into a post, generate hooks and hashtags, format text in bold and count characters.
- [Free LinkedIn Post Generator From News](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/tools/linkedin-post-generator): Paste a news article link or text and get a ready-to-edit LinkedIn post with a hook, your take and a question. Free, no sign-up, 10 posts a day.
- [Free LinkedIn Hook Generator: 5 Opening Lines](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/tools/linkedin-hook-generator): Describe your post or paste a draft and get five LinkedIn opening lines in different styles: question, bold claim, number, story and contrarian. Free, no sign-up.
- [Free LinkedIn Hashtag Generator for Posts](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/tools/linkedin-hashtag-generator): Paste your LinkedIn post or topic and get relevant hashtags, split into broad tags for reach and niche tags where you can stand out. Free, no sign-up.
- [Free LinkedIn Post Formatter & Character Counter](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/tools/linkedin-post-formatter): Format LinkedIn posts with bold and italic text, bullet lists and clean spacing, count characters against the 3,000 limit, and preview the "see more" cut. Free.

- [How to Build a Professional Personal Brand](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/how-to-build-a-personal-brand): A step-by-step personal branding strategy: choose a territory, build a point of view, publish consistently and turn visibility into opportunity.

- [How to Use AI to Write LinkedIn Posts](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/how-to-use-ai-to-write-linkedin-posts): A practical workflow for using AI to create LinkedIn posts faster, without losing your voice, your credibility or your readers' trust.
- [How to Turn News into LinkedIn Posts](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/turn-industry-news-into-linkedin-posts): A repeatable method for turning articles and industry news into insightful LinkedIn posts that build authority, not just reshares.

- [How Often Should You Post on LinkedIn?](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/how-often-to-post-on-linkedin): The honest answer to how often you should post on LinkedIn, and how to choose a frequency you can actually sustain.
- [How to Repurpose Articles for Social Media](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/repurpose-articles-into-social-media-posts): Turn one article, report or blog post into several useful social posts across LinkedIn and other networks, each adapted rather than copied.
- [10 Personal Branding Mistakes to Avoid](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/personal-branding-mistakes-to-avoid): The most common personal branding mistakes on LinkedIn and beyond, why they hold professionals back, and what to do instead.
- [How to Stay Updated on Industry Trends](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/how-to-stay-updated-on-industry-trends): A practical system for following and curating industry news as a busy professional, and turning what you learn into visible expertise.
- [Develop a Professional Point of View](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/how-to-develop-a-professional-point-of-view): A point of view is what turns expertise into authority. Here's how to find yours, test it and express it in insightful industry commentary.
- [Guide to Multi-Platform Social Posting](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/one-voice-ten-platforms): Your audience isn't only on LinkedIn anymore. Here's how to show up consistently on ten platforms without sounding like ten different people.
- [The 15-Minute Content Calendar](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/15-minute-content-calendar): You don't need a content team to post consistently. You need a repeatable 15-minute weekly ritual — here's exactly what it looks like.
- [Can AI-Written Posts Still Sound Like You?](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/ai-content-still-sound-like-you): Generic AI content is easy to spot and easy to ignore. Here's the difference between AI that writes for you and AI that writes as you.
- [LinkedIn Algorithm 2026: What Changed](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/linkedin-algorithm-2026): Dwell time matters more than ever, external links are still quietly penalized, and comments in the first hour remain the single biggest lever.
- [Why Generic AI Content Fails](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/generic-ai-content-fails): "Write me a post about AI" produces content anyone could have written. The fix isn't a better prompt — it's better source material.
- [Personal Brand vs Company Brand](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/personal-brand-vs-company-brand): A strong company page builds trust in the business. A strong personal voice builds trust in the people running it. Neither replaces the other.
- [Beyond LinkedIn: Reddit and Mastodon](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/beyond-linkedin-reddit-mastodon): Different platforms, different unwritten rules. Here's how to tell when a channel is worth your time — and how to not get banned in week one.
- [Why Consistency Beats Virality](https://www.thesocialpundit.com/blog/why-consistency-beats-virality): One viral post gets you a week of attention. Fifty ordinary posts over a year get you a reputation. Only one of those compounds.
